changelog: CRITICAL: Removed composer dump-autoload from update process
Fixes 7-minute timeout during updates on XAMPP
Update now completes in seconds instead of minutes
Laravel autoloader regenerates automatically on next request
No more 'Connection Error' during cache clearing
Instant success response after file extraction
description: Critical performance fix - removed slow composer dump-autoload step that caused 7-minute delays and connection timeouts on XAMPP. Updates now complete instantly with success message displaying immediately.
